decisions.reason: The handle family sits close to the core offer and survived the 2019 pruning that removed other 2018 handles, which signals results at or above aspiration in a growing industry where a large firm has slack to carry it.

The design stayed on the website while comparable 2018 handle designs were dropped, so it appears to meet aspirations, though handle designs turn over regularly and it carries some risk of a future range refresh.

The electronic access system was rebranded and upgraded to 'LightAccess Pro' in 2019 and fits the firm's strategic move toward digital building organization, so management has reason to keep investing in it rather than search for alternatives.
